appetite.statement: No tolerance for loss of client data. Limited, short service disruption is acceptable.
Zero tolerance for unauthorised payments. Every payment of €100,000 or more needs dual control.
Critical client services restored within 4 hours; no more than 8 hours of cumulative outage a year.
Critical suppliers assessed every year and covered by a tested exit plan.
No regulatory deadline missed; no material finding left open past its due date.
Errors are expected and corrected; training completion of at least 90 %.

controls.title: Information security policy set approved by management
controls.description: Policy framework (ISMS) reviewed yearly and approved by the CEO; communicated to all staff.

controls.title: Quarterly privileged access review
controls.description: Admin rights on ERP, IdP and cloud consoles re-certified by owners each quarter.

controls.title: Joiner-mover-leaver access process
controls.description: HR triggers account creation, change and removal; leavers disabled on the last day.

controls.title: Call-back verification of supplier bank-detail changes
controls.description: Any IBAN change is confirmed by phone using a number already on file, by someone other than the requester.

controls.title: Central logging and security alerting
controls.description: Logs from IdP, ERP, firewall and cloud VMs centralised; alert rules reviewed monthly.

controls.title: Incident response procedure with regulatory clocks
controls.description: Triage, roles, evidence and notification timelines for NIS2, GDPR and client DORA obligations.

controls.title: Daily immutable backups with quarterly restore test
controls.description: Backups to a separate object-storage vault with retention lock; restore tested each quarter.

controls.title: Business continuity plan and annual exercise
controls.description: BIA-based continuity plan for tier 1–2 processes, exercised yearly.

controls.title: Vulnerability scanning and patch SLA
controls.description: Weekly scans; critical patches within 7 days, high within 30 days.

controls.title: Change management with approval
controls.description: Production changes need a ticket, peer review and approval; emergency changes reviewed after.

controls.title: Perimeter firewall rule review
controls.description: Rules re-certified each quarter; unused rules removed.

controls.title: Security, audit and exit clauses in supplier contracts
controls.description: Standard clauses: security obligations, audit rights, incident notice, sub-processor approval, exit assistance.

controls.title: Asset inventory with criticality ratings
controls.description: Information assets and supporting systems listed with owner and criticality 1–4.

controls.title: Threat intelligence review
controls.description: Weekly review of CERT-FR and vendor advisories against the asset inventory.

controls.title: Encryption at rest and in transit
controls.description: TLS 1.2+ everywhere; storage and backups encrypted with managed keys.

controls.title: Dual control for payments of €100,000 or more
controls.description: Finance Director and CEO must both approve; enforced by the approval policy.

controls.title: Segregation of duties enforced in the approval workflow
controls.description: Requester cannot approve, approvers cannot execute, executors cannot verify. Enforced by the database, not by the screen.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication on the SSO tenant
controls.description: MFA enforced for all workforce identities; risky sign-ins raise an alert counted by the R2 KRI.

controls.title: Security awareness and phishing training
controls.description: Onboarding module plus two phishing simulations per year; completion tracked by the R3 KRI.

controls.title: Tamper-evident audit trail
controls.description: Every governance event is hash-chained; the database refuses edits and deletions.

controls.title: Multi-zone deployment and failover runbook
controls.description: Client-facing services run in two availability zones; failover documented, uptime tracked by the R1 KRI.

controls.title: Supplier security due diligence and tiering
controls.description: Suppliers tiered by criticality and data access; critical tier assessed yearly; tracked by the R5 KRI.

controls.title: Records of processing and DPIA process
controls.description: Article 30 register maintained; DPIA screening for new processing; compliance gaps tracked by the R6 KRI.

controls.title: Capacity monitoring and SLA early warning
controls.description: Utilisation and SLA breaches monitored per client; R4 KRI escalates above threshold.

controls.title: Treatment plans tracked to deadline
controls.description: Every treatment action has an owner and deadline; overdue actions are escalated to management.

risk_quant.rationale: Cloud region or zone incidents a few times a year; loss = SLA credits, overtime and churn risk on the largest clients. Case-study estimate (calibrated expert range), not historical loss data.

Credential phishing attempts reach staff monthly; a successful takeover drives investigation, client notification and possible fraud. Case-study estimate (calibrated expert range), not historical loss data.
Frequent minor mistakes during onboarding; most are caught, a few cause rework or data exposure. Case-study estimate (calibrated expert range), not historical loss data.
Peak loads and staff absence; loss = SLA penalties and escalations. Case-study estimate (calibrated expert range), not historical loss data.
One key subcontractor failure every one to two years; loss = replacement cost and delays. Case-study estimate (calibrated expert range), not historical loss data.
Audit or regulatory findings; loss = remediation, legal fees and potential fines. Case-study estimate (calibrated expert range), not historical loss data.
Business-email-compromise attempts on finance several times a year; loss per event sized on the €184,500 case. Case-study estimate (calibrated expert range), not historical loss data.
Attempts on ERP and finance accounts; loss = fraud, forensic work and audit consequences. Case-study estimate (calibrated expert range), not historical loss data.

policies.body:
## Purpose
Protect client services and data, and meet NIS2, GDPR and contractual obligations.

## Commitments
- Risks are assessed with EBIOS RM and recorded in the risk register.
- Every control has an owner and is tested on a schedule.
- Management reviews security risks every quarter.

## Your duties
- Protect your credentials and use MFA.
- Report any suspected incident immediately to the security team.

policies.summary: Top-level commitments, roles and the security baseline every team applies.

policies.body:
## Rules
- Company data stays on approved systems.
- No personal cloud storage for work files.
- Lock your screen when you leave your desk.

- MFA is mandatory for every account, including subcontractors.
- Admin rights are reviewed every quarter.
- Leavers lose access on their last working day.
policies.title: Access Control and Authentication
policies.summary: Least privilege, MFA, privileged access reviews and leaver removal.

policies.body:
## Rules
- Any change of supplier bank details is confirmed by phone, using a number already on file, by someone other than the requester.
- Payments of €100,000 or more need approval by the Finance Director and the CEO.
- Urgent payment requests by email are treated as suspicious.
policies.title: Payments and Supplier Master Data
policies.summary: Call-back verification of bank-detail changes and dual control above €100,000.

policies.body:
## Timelines
- NIS2: early warning within 24 h, notification within 72 h, final report within one month.
- GDPR: notify the CNIL within 72 h of awareness where feasible.
- Client DORA obligations: support clients to file within their deadlines.
policies.title: Incident Response and Notification
policies.summary: Triage, escalation and regulatory notification timelines.

policies.body:
## Objectives
- Tier 1: restore within 4 h, lose at most 1 h of data.
- Tier 2: restore within 24 h.
- Exercise the plan at least once a year.
policies.title: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
policies.summary: Recovery objectives per tier and the annual exercise.

policies.body:
## Rules
- Critical suppliers are assessed every year.
- Contracts include security obligations, audit rights, incident notice and exit assistance.
policies.title: Supplier Security
policies.summary: Tiering, due diligence and contract clauses for suppliers.

policies.body:
## Rules
- New processing is screened for a DPIA.
- Every personal-data breach is recorded, notifiable or not.
policies.title: Personal Data Protection (GDPR)
policies.summary: Lawful processing, records of processing, DPIA and breach handling.

policies.body:
## Rules
- Daily backups, immutable for 30 days.
- Restore tested every quarter and recorded.
policies.title: Backup and Recovery
policies.summary: Backup frequency, immutability and restore testing.

policies.body:
## Draft rules
- Laptops are encrypted and updated automatically.
- Public Wi-Fi only through the company VPN.
policies.title: Remote Work and Devices
policies.summary: Draft: encryption, updates and home-network rules for laptops.
